purpose: Show offline accuracy against model size for the speech-to-text variants: larger or more accurate transcription does not buy sentiment macro-F1.
encodings: two panels side by side sharing the x axis (size in MB, linear): left, Cardiff macro-F1 with CI error bars per variant; right, WER vs gold per variant; each point labelled with the variant's short name (offset labels so they do not collide); same marker color per variant in both panels (fixed order AventIQ, s2t-small, whisper-tiny, whisper-base, moonshine-base)

axes.x: size of the files a service loads (MB)
axes.y_left: macro-F1 with the Cardiff sentiment model (test slice)
axes.y_right: word error rate vs human transcripts

caption: Accuracy against size for the five speech-to-text variants. Moonshine-base has the lowest word error rate but the lowest sentiment macro-F1; the three Whisper variants sit within each other's confidence intervals.
